application.name: AprilTag Detection
application.description: Renders synthetic AprilTag scenes, detects the tags with holoscan-apriltag's AprilTagDetectorOp on every compiled backend, checks each detection against ground truth, and shows the first backend's detections on a HoloViz display.

changelog.1.0.0: Initial release: the holoscan-apriltag demo, with a synthetic source checked against ground truth and a HoloViz overlay.

hardware.name: NVIDIA GPU
hardware.description: A CUDA-capable GPU supported by the Holoscan SDK.

synthetic.description: Detect tags in a rendered scene with every compiled backend and with the one auto picks for the platform, check them against ground truth, and display the first backend's detections when a display is available.

ci.description: Finite headless check: 30 synthetic frames (120 tags) through every compiled backend and auto, verified against ground truth; on a CI runner, auto must pick vpi on the Jetson's PVA and cuda on x86_64.
